column1: JV3 COMPUTE COOPERATIVE - PARTNER SUMMARY v4 (as of 14 Jul 2026)

Three AI labs jointly build ~100MW of NVIDIA compute in France as a FIRM program (T1-T5), with two further tranches held as unpriced options. Each member owns an equal 1/3 sleeve of every tranche and commits to it via take-or-pay with credit support. GB300 starts in rented colo (live month 6); a dedicated campus is built for Vera Rubin. This is a MEMBER COST SCHEDULE - outbound cash only, no revenue modelled. Full engine: jv_economics_v4.csv. Supersedes v3 files.

Nothing here is an executed quote. GB300 rack $4.0M is a street-band estimate (Loop Capital $3.7-4.0M); Rubin $8.5Mx1.15 is the conservative complete case (low case $7.8M configured); PropCo $267.5M/block from Turner&Townsend Paris benchmarks + owner costs (range $260-275M).

Dense FP8 basis: GB300 360 PF/rack (720 sparse halved), Rubin 1,260 PF/rack -> 3.50x per GPU, ~2.19x per equal MW. FP4 marketing flops not used. 'Normalized GB300-Watt' = watts of GB300 delivering the same dense FP8.

Electricity: nameplate x PUE 1.20 x 90% electrical load factor x EUR90/MWh all-in-delivered planning case x $1.143/EUR (ECB). EUR70 commodity is not an all-in price. Colo $130/kW-mo billed on 1/3 of a 20MW reservation (sensitivities 130/155/180).

Timing scenarios: GB300 order-to-live 6mo base (16wk only if colo + allocation fully ready; 8-10mo downside). Rubin construction 21mo modelled (fast-track site); 22-24mo standard base would shift T3 to ~m24 and T5 to ~m36.

Site: to be selected - subject to executed exclusivity, grid-connection offer, permits, water/fibre/geotech diligence. No RTE entitlement claimed. EU/French public capital (up to ~17% of eligible capex) is UPSIDE ONLY - the base assumes zero subsidy.

Interest starts at GPU purchase: each GB300 sleeve pays ~$8M interest during the 6-month rack-up before compute. Not netted: 10% chip residual memo (~$0.11B/member) and PropCo residual life (~12yrs at schedule end).
Members commit via two-leg take-or-pay (reserved-capacity fee payable irrespective of usage) with backer credit support (LC/guarantee) - the basis on which lenders underwrite.
